intro: Khao Takiab is Hua Hin's southernmost beach, around 6 km from the town centre, marked by the rocky headland with Wat Khao Takiab on top. The sand along this stretch is noticeably wider and quieter than the central beach, and beachfront places run from budget apartments to 5-star pool villas. The appeal is falling asleep to the waves and long morning walks on the beach, while still being close to Cicada Market and the Tamarind night market at weekends, with central Hua Hin a 10–15 minute drive away. It works well for families, couples and anyone who wants a relaxed seaside setting without the bustle. The trade-off is fewer shops and places to eat nearby than in town, so if you want to walk to food every meal you may end up driving in fairly often, or renting a scooter or car to get around.

blocks.html: Short answer: Khao Takiab is Hua Hin's southern beach strip, about 6 km from town, lined with beachfront resorts where the sand is wider and quieter than in the centre. The temple-topped headland is the landmark, and it sits near Cicada Market and the Tamarind night market. It suits anyone who wants a calm seaside base but still wants town within a 10–15 minute drive. Rates start around ฿1,100 and climb into the several thousands for pool villas.

items.name: Takiab Beach Resort
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Budget · cheap beachfront · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small resort of around 27 rooms right on Khao Takiab beach. The building is older but kept clean, with balconies, air-con and fridges in the rooms, plus an outdoor pool and a children's pool. The draw is the cheapest starting rate in the area while still being genuinely on the sand. Reviews praise the friendly staff and a location close to the beach, Wat Khao Takiab and Cicada Market. A good fit for budget travellers or anyone who plans to be out most of the day and just wants a low-cost bed by the sea.

items.name: Lahabana Huahin
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Longer stays · kitchen units near Cicada · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A seafront aparthotel about 300 metres from Cicada Market and a few minutes' walk from the beach. Units come with a kitchenette, microwave, fridge and kettle, which suits self-catering or multi-night stays, and there's a heated pool and private parking. Reviews praise the clean, newer building and an attractive lobby, plus a location within walking distance of both Cicada Market and the Tamarind night market at weekends. Best for families and travellers who want apartment-style space near the markets rather than a standard hotel room.

items.name: Nern Chalet Beachfront Hotel
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Sunrise views · value beachfront · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 3-star beachfront hotel on Khao Takiab beach where most rooms face the sea, with balconies and views toward the headland. Its strength is the sunrise outlook straight from the sand, and there's a pool and free breakfast. Reviews praise the views from the lobby and room balconies as well as helpful staff; the building is fairly old but still in good condition. A good fit for couples and families who want a sea-view beachfront room at an accessible price, with Wat Khao Takiab within easy walking distance.

items.name: The Rock Hua Hin Beachfront Spa Resort
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Spa · beachfront boutique · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 4-star beachfront boutique resort in the Khao Takiab area, with a pool by the sand overlooking the Gulf and a signature cave-themed Cave Spa as its calling card. Rooms have a resort look and many face the sea; it sits about 700 metres from Cicada Market and runs a shuttle into town. Tripadvisor reviews highlight clean, attractive rooms, friendly staff and a calm seaside atmosphere. A good fit for couples and anyone wanting a compact beachfront resort with a full spa, without paying 5-star rates.

items.name: Wora Bura Hua Hin Resort & Spa
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Private beach · colonial-Thai style · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star beachfront resort on Khao Takiab beach with a private beach area, done in a colonial-Thai style set in leafy gardens around a large pool, with a spa and seaside restaurants. It's roughly a 10-minute walk from the Tamarind and Cicada markets. It rates consistently well, with guests praising the calm atmosphere, warm staff and pretty grounds, though some note a few dated areas. A good fit for couples and families who want a classic-feeling 5-star beachfront resort at a still-accessible price.

items.name: VERSO Hua Hin - a Veranda Collection
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Modern design · sky pool · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A newer design hotel on Khao Takiab beach from the Veranda Collection, with just 38 rooms plus a sky-pool suite. Rooms are clean and modern, many with sea-view balconies, and there's a private beach, an outdoor pool, a spa, and a beachfront restaurant and café. The selling point is the contemporary design and a small boutique feel, with the Hua Hin night market under a 10-minute drive away. A good fit for couples and anyone who prefers a design-led hotel focused on calm and looks over the facilities of a big resort.

items.name: The Yana Villas Hua Hin
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Pool villas · beachfront honeymoon · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star villa resort on Khao Takiab beach with a private beach area. Many villas have a private pool, garden or jacuzzi, and the upper villas come with sea views and daybeds; there's an infinity pool, a fitness room and tropical gardens. It rates very highly, with guests praising the good-looking rooms, cleanliness and staff, plus complimentary in-room drinks and snacks. A good fit for honeymooners and anyone wanting a private beachfront pool villa in the Khao Takiab area, with town still a short drive away.

faq.q: How is Khao Takiab different from central Hua Hin?
faq.a: Central Hua Hin is close to the train station, the night market, restaurants and shops you can browse all day, but the beach there is busier and narrower. Khao Takiab is about 6 km south, with a wider, quieter beach and beachfront resorts across a range of price points, though there's less to eat and fewer shops nearby. Choose the centre if you want to walk to food and drinks every meal; choose Khao Takiab for a calmer beach and a relaxed seaside base, then drive or ride into town now and then.

faq.q: From Khao Takiab, is it easy to reach Cicada Market and the town?
faq.a: Cicada Market and the Tamarind night market run at weekends and are in the Khao Takiab area itself — many hotels are within walking distance or a few minutes' drive. Central Hua Hin is about a 10–15 minute drive, served by the green songthaew that runs between Khao Takiab and town, plus taxis, some hotel shuttles and ride-hailing apps. If you plan to head into town or eat out often, renting a scooter or car is more convenient and cheaper over a longer stay.

faq.q: Is Khao Takiab good for families with kids?
faq.a: Yes. Khao Takiab beach is wide and the waves are usually gentle, so children can wander and build sandcastles easily. Many resorts here have pools, children's pools or villas with space for kids to run around, and it's close to Wat Khao Takiab with its resident monkeys and to Cicada Market with food stalls and open areas. One caveat: during the monsoon months the surf and wind can pick up, so watch for warning flags and ask the hotel before letting children swim — and it helps to pick a place with a pool as a backup.
